1. Case overview

Summary. 9 plans were evaluated: 7 DMAT variants and 2 reference plans.

Clinical background and rationale. Pancreatic targets prescribed 33 and 50 Gy in five fractions. The comparison examines coverage at both dose levels alongside duodenal and duodenal-PRV dose.

Plan generation. DMAT plan generated for: Accela. DMAT: 10FFF; 1 arc; modulation −3, −2, −1, 0, +1, +2, +3. Reference setup: Ethos 12-field IMRT — 6FFF, 12 fields; TB VMAT 10FFF — 10FFF, 2 arcs.

Goal setup. The DMAT source reports contained 22 provided goals per plan, with priority identifiers, goal thresholds and acceptable-variation fields. Derived and automatic objectives were listed separately. For DMAT -3, examples were GTVp V50.00 Gy ≥ 95.0 % (P2.2); Body D0.0 % < 74.75 Gy (P1.1).

Comparison methods. Dose colorwash, DVHs, individual endpoint–time plots and the saved 25-endpoint scorecard were compared. All saved dose factors were 1.0; no additional rescaling was applied. Scores summarize the selected endpoints. DMAT timing came from matched metrics; reference timing used an RT Plan control-point estimate.

2. Dose colorwash

Compare target coverage and dose spread at the same slice. Slice positions are synchronized across plans.

Scroll over a dose image to change slices. Use the slider or arrow keys as an alternative. Dragging is disabled.

Dose viewer loads when visible.
10 GySIB 33 GySIB 50 Gy75 Gy

Manual color anchors: 30.5→50 Gy. Anchor doses remain fixed when the display range changes.

Colorwash sampling details

Every dose is evaluated on DMAT -3’s patient-coordinate dose grid before CT slices are sampled every 5 mm from its isocenter. Native grids that differ are trilinearly resampled. The in-plane display and superior–inferior slice range are restricted to the selected reference plan’s 40% prescription-dose bounding volume plus 50 mm in every direction; CT slices outside that range are not embedded. Each colorwash has a slim slice slider beneath it; moving any slider advances every plan synchronously. The compact zoom buttons, pointer drag, and reset remain synchronized and persist while changing slices. Mouse-wheel scrolling continues to move the report page. All plans use the confirmed 10–75 Gy color scale.
